assumptions: Polynomial bounds are in explicit physical length N, not succinct log N. M6 is used only in its anchored all-order R<N domain. Full gcd multiplicities are retained. Non-Cartesian means no recipe-equivalent proper coprime separated-direction presentation; broader code or Clifford inequivalence is not established. No SELF, scalar oracle or review vote is assumed.
bound: O((N+1)^6) indexed-array bit work and O((N+1)^3) data bits; common conservative deterministic sequential bound O((N+1)^12) time and O((N+1)^4) storage. Includes preprocessing, failed discovery, full gcds, O(N)-bit signed coefficients, all pins and inverse witness transport. No executed performance claim.
claim: Consolidated c=1 orbit-logarithmic-span recognizer and exact physical-distance/minimum-witness theorem. Discovery, optimizer and coverage interfaces are reconciled. Mathematical synthesis is supplied at analytic-draft strength; actual artifact freeze, two independent full-scope reviews and M8 acceptance remain outstanding.
cutoffs_and_constant_losses: Fixed c=1; L=min(N-1,floor(log2(N+1))) computed by bit length. Accepted state count 2^R<=N+1. No approximation or physical-weight loss. At most 2N^3 discovery trials and 2N additional paired trace queries. Sequential bounds deliberately use a conservative fixed overhead.
region: Explicit N>=1, two nonempty equal-weight binary supports, within-block-difference gcd equal to 1. Surviving inputs are accepted exactly when an anchored presentation under independent translations, one common unit and block exchange has R<=min(N-1,floor(log2(N+1))). Includes odd/even non-Cartesian families and repeated F.
selector_requirements: Lexicographic anchor-tuple discovery tests actual arrays and stores the winning transformation. Translation enumeration recognizes the same predicate but may select a different first tuple. Minimum decoding uses exact positive weight-d counts and at most 2N tentative zero pins. Inverse transport removes translations, applies the inverse common unit, then undoes exchange.
source_sign_output_scope: GF(2) cycles C=ker[b a], boundaries D=im(a,b). Exact signed integer character traces count physical coefficient weights. Boundary normalization is 2^-deg(F'); character normalization is 2^-N with swapped/inverted pins. Returns original F and NoLogical, or exact d with original-coordinate nonboundary witness, or Unrecognized.
uncovered: Every F!=1 input with R_orb>L returns Unrecognized, including the connected antipodal family N=2^v>=8, a=b=(1+x)(1+x^(N/2)). NoLogical occurs exactly at F=1. Other structural regimes, all-input optimization and family-preserving hardness are not solved. Explicit covered families overlap M6's fixed-span domain.
